result.reason: The episode adds useful evidence for branch-isolated parallel execution and a blob-verified publication fallback, but one successful publication cycle is insufficient to generalize a new prompt Candidate. The existing unit-verdict Candidate behaved correctly in two scopes yet still lacks deterministic VERIFIED_FOR_SCOPE activation evidence.
retained_learning: Authorized parallel writers can remain auditable by isolating branch, native Run, invocation scope, idempotency key, and changed files while serializing eventual main integration.

When direct Git transport is unavailable, Git blob/tree/commit/ref operations can preserve an exact local tree if every returned blob SHA is compared with the local Git object SHA before ref creation.
The side-effect record must distinguish publication success, CI association, CI terminal success, and merge; none may be inferred from another.
CI waiting should not stop independent non-overlapping work, but a moved PR head must receive its own exact-head validation.
